arguments.description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet.

criteria.scope: CORRECTED FUTURE CONTRACT v2 (2026-11-07 PHASE review, round 2 after independent caller comparison work/queue.ready-handoff/caller-review.json sha256 bfb6f0cf561d6fffcfa91d7ebf7e9f6920326c5a6f1f225b498500ed8be9b1ad, finding C1). Distinct from the historical plan work/queue.ready-revision/candidate-plan.json (sha256 e7f85aa1f115b4f4c40cc5fc7c6e16a6313b4db36df4d133823241b9923750f6) that governed the delivered candidate ready.retained and its six retained verdicts ready.delivery.review.verdict.0..5, and from the round-1 corrected plan work/queue.ready-handoff/candidate-plan.json (sha256 e58e0e3ebe7fbaa303515022c46efd9fc44b1b5c80f6c21273585f9eb0c08db0), which is superseded by this file but retained unchanged because PLAR evidence and the round-1 handoff reference it. Round-1 had altered outputs[0].contract.intent by dropping the word 'later' ('...for later assets/ready-confirmed.png.'); v2 restores the historical intent verbatim so that this file differs from the historical plan ONLY in this scope statement and in criterion source pointers. This file changes NO criterion id, check, domain, mode, basis, scope sentence, authority or contract field; it only repairs citation locators to file-local inclusive line bounds and splits over-broad ranges so each pointer cites exactly the text its locator names. It is NOT an authorization for a new provider request and does NOT retroactively replace the historical plan or transplant its verdicts. Representative Ready status sample (queue.ready) for style review before family expansion. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png are later-stage obligations recorded in request-review.v2.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.
